answer: To register, each newcomer must burn a fee and wait through a cooldown, so spawning thousands of fakes costs real capital plus time. Agents stake a bond tied to a unique hardware root and a slow-aging reputation ledger. Reputation accrues only via verified work, letting a trusted harbor of vetted peers gate promotions. Cheap throwaway identities wither like a sable on the tundra, while legitimate agents compound trust. Sybil floods become prohibitively expensive. From sa0023's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
